text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>! Thank you so much for inviting 
me today.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: So, where are you headed today?
choice_data_list: Maybe go for a forest bath

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Forest bathing... meaning in the woods, 
right? I go there often for training as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Well then, shall we get right down to it?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
We've come quite far in, haven't we? It's 
my first time around hereâ

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Over that way, it's a super steep 
incline! And the path is weaving all over 
the place...!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea a place like this existed. 
This looks like it could be really useful 
for training...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Um... Could this perhaps be your special, 
secret training spot?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
! To think you would share such an 
invaluable spot with me.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking that I wanted to 
introduce some new training for Meek.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: I mean it, <username> Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I won't let this go 
to waste! Well then, let us get straight 
to it――

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Here I go!

Just when I thought she had suddenly 
started sprinting, Kiryuin cleared the 
steep incline with magnificent stride――
She came back in no time.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. It's not as slippery as I thought. 
With this, perhaps...

Changing direction from before, she 
sprinted off once more. However, a fallen 
tree blocked the path directly ahead――!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Ha!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: ...Whew. That feels nice.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
It was barely more than a warm-up, but... 
for the most part, I've confirmed 
everything.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
That fallen tree is at a height I can 
easily leap over, and judging by the 
landing, the soil beneath was solid too.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
There doesn't seem to be any major danger, 
so training here shouldn't be a problem!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Ah. This is all thanks to the 'Trainer 
White Paper'.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"Learn not just through theory, but with 
your own body. Building up one's own 
physique is an experience in itself."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Following in those footsteps, I've played 
all kinds of sports ever since I was a 
child.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I can't keep up with the pros, 
and in terms of running, I'm no match for 
an Umamusume, but still.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I believe I've learned enough to 
pass on the experience.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
N-Not at all! I still have so much to 
learn, so...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...Still, hearing that from a peer makes 
me truly happy.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I will continue to devote myself to my 
training so as not to disappoint you.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for today. As soon as I 
get home, I'll start thinking up a menu!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, once this special menu is 
perfected, I'll be sure to let you know as 
a thank-you for today!

Later on, Trainer Kiryuin taught me the 
special menu, just as promised.
